paragraphs: SportReach sells an all-in-one platform for sports registration, payment processing, event operations and marketing. The homepage frames it as a replacement for separate sports registration, CRM, email, SMS, volunteer, sponsorship and fundraising systems. Included tools cover event day participant check-in by QR code, volunteer coordination, reporting downloads, invoicing and payment tracking.

A banner on the homepage lists campus rec departments, parks and rec, sports commissions and state games. A second banner lists team sports, tournaments, leagues, running and cycling events and club sports.

The company claims over ninety unique sport types across hundreds of sports organizations and thousands of events. Since 2011, SportReach has been working with events, clubs and team sports organizations.

quote.text: SportReach powers over ninety unique sport types across hundreds of sports organizations and thousands of events.
